name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demo a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny. Tato verze snizuje Direct2D resource churn: solid brushe pro text, fill, border a rim se sdileji v jednom paint passu a diagnostika hlasi create/reuse pocty.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources. This version reduces Direct2D resource churn: solid brushes for text, fill, border, and rim are shared within one paint pass, with diagnostics for create/reuse counts.
